quotes.text: We should only use id inside a primary type definition.

In Thunderbird extension APIs, use id on a primary entity type and <entity>Id when another object/query refers to that entity. Examples: MailFolder.id versus folderId; MailTab.tabId references the tabs API; ComposeRecipient.nodeId references contacts/mailinglist nodes; spaces query.spaceId. This accepted naming rule is applied to Manifest V3, with explicit schema min/max manifest gates and output conversion preserving V2 id. Do not rename V2 properties unconditionally. Keep schema, implementation, documentation and version-specific tests aligned.
